grade_rationale: 6 P1 findings total (5 security CVEs + 1 missing route). Config threshold: C=max_p1:2, D=anything worse. P2 count: 6. Active spec coverage ~90% (FR-WF 100%, FR-dependency 81%).
scope: Full codebase — static analysis only (services offline)
skip_reason: Services not running; dynamic mode unavailable

escalations.title: vitest <3.2.6 — Remote Code Execution via Prototype Pollution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Tinypool worker options prototype pollution; network-accessible, no auth required. Any user on network can trigger RCE in test/CI pipeline.
escalations.recommendation: npm install vitest@^3.2.6 --save-dev in Source/Frontend and portal/Backend

escalations.title: proxy-addr <2.0.8 — IP Spoofing bypasses access controls (CVSS 9.1)
escalations.exploit_scenario: IPv4-mapped IPv6 address handling allows spoofed source IP. Any network attacker can bypass IP-based firewalling, rate limiting, or ACLs on all 4 express services.
escalations.recommendation: npm install express@^4.20.0 in all 4 affected projects (bundles fixed proxy-addr)

escalations.title: protobufjs <=7.5.5 — 12 CVEs: Code Execution, DoS, Prototype Pollution
escalations.exploit_scenario: Code injection through bytes field defaults, DoS via crafted field names, arbitrary code execution via generated code. Affects infrastructure orchestrator.
escalations.recommendation: npm install protobufjs@>=7.6.0 in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend

escalations.title: handlebars <=4.7.8 — Template Injection / RCE via AST Confusion (CVSS 8.1)
cve_refs: handlebars JS injection via AST type confusion
escalations.exploit_scenario: If any user-controlled input reaches a Handlebars template in Source/Backend, server-side template injection leads to arbitrary code execution.
escalations.recommendation: npm audit fix in Source/Backend (or npm install handlebars@>4.7.8)

escalations.title: tinypool <=2.1.0 — Prototype Pollution RCE (transitive via vitest)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Same tinypool prototype pollution vector as DA-001. Affects CI/CD test execution paths in 3 projects.
escalations.recommendation: Resolved by updating vitest to >=3.2.6 (see DA-001)
escalations.cross_ref: DA-001 (same root cause — single fix resolves both)

findings.title: GET /api/search not wired — 5 tests known-failing
findings.exploit_scenario: No exploit — missing feature. Frontend DependencyPicker calls GET /api/search which 404s. Full-stack integration is broken end-to-end. 5 test cases document the contract but fail.
findings.recommendation: Implement Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and wire with app.use('/api/search', searchRouter). Test contract is already written.

findings.title: 3 route files bypass service layer — import store directly
findings.exploit_scenario: Not an exploit — architecture rule violation. Direct store imports couple routes to storage, block testability, and violate CLAUDE.md layering rule.
findings.recommendation: Extract CRUD operations into workItemService.ts. Routes call service, service calls store.

findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md is orphaned — 74 FRs unimplemented
findings.exploit_scenario: Not an exploit — spec confusion risk. Future agents reading Specifications/ see 74 unimplemented FRs with no context that this is a different or archived system.
findings.recommendation: Mark spec [SUPERSEDED], [PLANNED], or add header note. Extend traceability enforcer to cover or explicitly exclude this spec.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer never scans dependency-linking plan (FR-dependency-* blind spot)
findings.exploit_scenario: CI shows green traceability while QO-001 (missing search route) exists. The enforcer only targets the most-recently-modified plan file.
findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to accept multiple plan files or add a second CI pass for Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md

findings.title: DoS vulnerabilities: browserslist (OOM) and brace-expansion (process hang)
findings.exploit_scenario: Unbounded memory growth via browserslist; zero-step sequence causes process hang via brace-expansion. Affects build tooling and runtime.
findings.recommendation: npm audit fix across all affected projects

findings.title: body-parser size-enforcement bypass (CWE-770) and form-data CRLF injection
findings.exploit_scenario: body-parser allows oversized payloads bypassing size limits. form-data CRLF injection in multipart field names can corrupt headers.
findings.recommendation: npm audit fix; verify request size limits are enforced at middleware level

findings.title: @babel/core — arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL
findings.exploit_scenario: Crafted sourceMappingURL in transformed code can cause Babel to read arbitrary files from the filesystem during build.
findings.recommendation: Update @babel/core to patched version; run npm audit fix

findings.title: api/client.ts silently swallows JSON parse failure
findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining intentional suppression per CLAUDE.md silent-catch rule

findings.title: 2 eslint-disable suppressions without rationale comments
findings.recommendation: Add one-line comment above each eslint-disable explaining why the dependency is intentionally omitted

findings.title: Outdated major versions: pino (2 majors behind), uuid (3+ majors behind)
findings.recommendation: Plan upgrades: express@^4.20.0 (or 5.x), pino@^10.4.0, uuid@^14.0.3. Test for breaking changes.

findings.title: License compliance audit not completed (license-checker not installed)
findings.recommendation: npm install -g license-checker; run license audit against all 6 projects; document GPL/AGPL policy

findings.title: DebugPortalPage Verifies comment is not a valid FR reference
findings.recommendation: Replace with formal FR-WF-XXX reference or add '// No FR — dev tooling only'
